run.pipeline: Augur 0.3.0 - Phase 1 Step 3: LLM API candidate labeling

llm.invocation_mode: in-session labeling by the agent's underlying LLM (no external LLM API calls)

prompt_contract.system: Classify candidate APIs for a single CWE pass (pass 2, CWE-78); prefer conservative recall; mark sanitizers only with concrete evidence; do not auto-treat every network message field as a source or every subprocess call as a confirmed vulnerability.
prompt_contract.row_contract: For each CSV row: read the real source at file:line (and its enclosing function), then decide (a) is the data external input, (b) can an attacker control it, (c) is it validated/transformed/constrained, (d) is it a CWE-78 taint-tracking source / a genuine command-execution sink with a dangerous argument index, (e) shell vs argv-list mode, (f) effective sanitizers or internal wrappers.
prompt_contract.labels: role in {source,sink,sanitizer,summary,none}; classification in {tp,fp,candidate,unknown}; evidence must cite verbatim source lines.

batches.note: all exec sites: passexec, master_password hook, psql Popen / winpty spawn / cmd.exe write, getoutput binary-path probes, BatchProcess pipeline (processes / process_executor), BatchProcess constructions, bundler + codegen static sites
request.data/form/args/json/values/files/cookies/headers/environ reads incl. req and request_object aliases
request-field decode idiom (v/data), provider API responses, server-generated responses, local templates/files, stored settings, DB rows, preference values, import files, env
@blueprint.route URL path params and @sio.on /pty socket handler params
config.<NAME> local settings module reads (trusted admin side)
os.environ reads/writes, argparse CLIs, sys.argv (incl. the process_executor command transport), set_binary_path/replace_binary_path/get_connection_str steps
